NOBODY IS TALKING ABOUT THIS:
Someone built htop for Claude Code sessions.

Every session. live. token count, context window %, rate limit status, ports. all in one terminal view.

Most people running Claude Code on long tasks find out they hit the limit when the session dies. this shows you 10 minutes before.

It's called abtop. "Like htop, but for AI coding agents."

Open source. Free.
(Link in the comments)
